scope: Autonomous follow-up: repair recreated store category mismatch and reduce repeated catalog merge work

fixes.before: After disposing/recreating StoreScreen under the same provider container, controls selected All while the feed still contained only the previous travel/club/daily category. Reproduced with a failing widget test.
fixes.change: Adopt the retained valid feed category once from the already-watched feed during first build. Do not send a new query, clear rows, reinitialize controllers in maintained routes, or repeatedly override local Recommended selection.
fixes.evidence: The widget test recreates the screen for travel, club and daily, verifies exact list snapshot reuse, matching chip state, one local metadata load and detached old controllers.

fixes.before: Appending each bundled row rescanned every previously appended result. Instrumented local-only merges read IDs 4,160 times for 64 templates and 65,792 times for 256 templates.
fixes.change: Track already present integer identities in a call-local set. Preserve server ordering/duplicates, local artwork/price tier and existing local duplicate behavior.
fixes.memory: Only a transient O(n) set of integer IDs is added to the existing merge. It is not retained after the call; no persistent document/image cache or larger bitmap target is introduced.

checked: Category initialization runs once per recreated widget and uses an already available feed snapshot; initial entry adds no transport or document generation.
Recommended mode is not overwritten when local selection changes after first build.

List merge membership checks are linear, with call-local identity bookkeeping only. Server rows remain in input order, repeated server rows remain present and bundled duplicates are appended once as before.
Catalog artwork builders, titles, free/paid flags, prices, saved album data and account-specific guards are preserved.
Actual account/session transitions, concurrent shared requests, rapid search navigation, hidden catalog preparation, scrolling/paging and category-strip visibility cases remain green.
New screen controllers detach on disposal; no additional animation, timer or recurring UI callback is added.

verification.test_harness_repair: Moved a diagnostic test import to the directive section and restarted the interrupted suite; final suite completed cleanly.
